symptoms.hpa_not_scaling: The autoscaler (HPA) cannot adjust the number of replicas.
symptoms.hpa_at_max_replicas: The autoscaler (HPA) has reached its upper replica limit.
symptoms.hpa_target_unhealthy: The workload scaled by the autoscaler (HPA) is unhealthy.

facts.hpa_target_not_found: {kind} {target}, the scaling target of autoscaler {hpa}, does not exist.
facts.hpa_metrics_condition: Autoscaler {hpa} reports that it cannot read its metrics (source: {metric}).
facts.hpa_scaling_limited: Autoscaler {hpa} runs {current} replicas, which equals its limit of {max}.
facts.hpa_target_degraded: {kind} {target}, scaled by autoscaler {hpa}, is not healthy: some of its replicas are unavailable or failing.

hypotheses.hpa_target_missing: The scaling target {kind} {target} of autoscaler {hpa} does not exist, so the autoscaler has nothing to scale.
hypotheses.hpa_metrics_unavailable: Autoscaler {hpa} cannot read the metrics it needs, so it does not change the number of replicas.
hypotheses.hpa_max_replicas_reached: Autoscaler {hpa} has reached its limit of {max} replicas and cannot add more.
hypotheses.hpa_target_unhealthy: The workload {kind} {target} scaled by autoscaler {hpa} is unhealthy; this may be why scaling does not help or metrics are missing.

recommendations.hpa_fix_scale_target: Create {kind} {target}, or point autoscaler {hpa} to an existing workload.
recommendations.hpa_check_metrics_source: Check the source that serves the metrics of autoscaler {hpa}: the metrics server for CPU and memory, or the metrics adapter for custom and external metrics.
recommendations.hpa_raise_max_replicas: Raise the replica limit of autoscaler {hpa} (now {max}), or reduce the load or the cost of each request.

steps.hpa_check_metrics_api: Check that the metrics API answers and returns metrics for the Pods of {kind} {target}; for utilization targets, the containers must declare resource requests.
steps.hpa_investigate_target: Open an investigation of {kind} {target} to find out why its replicas are unhealthy.

missing.hpa_target_unsupported: Autoscaler {hpa} scales {kind} {target}, a kind that Kubron does not read, so the state of the target is unknown.
